title: Compliance Canary: simulated-audit probes and automated remediation for data residency & retention drift
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Compliance Canary service that periodically runs simulated audit probes against customer tenancy and configuration to detect data residency and retention policy drift, bundle cryptographically verifiable evidence, and trigger automated remediation playbooks or operator alerts. The canary will operate in read-only mode for hosted accounts and use a hardened agent for Dedicated/Private deployments to execute localized checks. Goals: 1) detect configuration drift earlier than CI/ops cycles, 2) provide machine-readable evidence bundles for audits, 3) enable safe auto-remediation for low-risk drift patterns, and 4) surface human-review flows for high-risk findings.
acceptance_criteria: Canary runs scheduled probes across 3 common drift vectors: region tag mismatch, retention-period override, and policy-as-code divergence (hash mismatch)
Evidence bundles (JSON + signed manifest) are generated and stored to customer-specified audit buckets or Redwood secure store with retention metadata
Low-risk drift triggers auto-remediation playbook that applies policy-as-code corrective patch and creates an auditable PR/Change in platform config
High-risk drift raises an operator-ticket, includes evidence bundle link, and pauses any auto-remediation flow until manual approval
Integration tests simulate drift in a staging tenancy and assert detection + remediation within configured SLO (detection < 10m, remediation < 30m for auto cases)
steps: Design probe types and selectors (residency tags, retention knobs, IAM bindings)
Implement read-only probe runner with pluggable check modules and provenance signing
Create evidence bundler: canonicalize findings, add metadata, sign with service key, store location URI
Wire policy-as-code reconciler to remediation playbooks with canary-safe rollouts (dry-run, canary, full-apply)
Add Console UI endpoint to review findings, download evidence bundles, and approve remediation
Add metrics and traces: probe latency, findings/sec, remediation success rate, false-positive rate
